summary: RETEST FIX VERIFIED — DELETE /api/auth/me hardening is correct. 26/26 tests pass on /app/backend/tests/test_e3_security_regression.py (extended with 7 new tests under TestE3MeSelfArchiveWorker, TestE3MeAdminWithPeersArchived, TestE3MeSoleAdminBlocked, TestE3MeNoHardDeletePathExists). Covered scenarios: (1) worker self-delete → 200 {deleted:true}, row persists with status='zarchiwizowany', cannot re-login (401/403). (2) admin with peers (seed admin remains) self-delete → 200 {deleted:true}, row archived, cannot login. (3) sole active admin (transiently made sole by flipping seed.status via direct DB write, restored in try/finally + fixture guard) → 400 with 'ostatni administrator' message, throwaway admin NOT archived (status=aktywny), can still login. (4) Static grep on server.py: NO db.users.delete_one/delete_many anywhere — every user-delete path is soft-archive. (5) Audit-log consistency: every 'usuniecie_wlasnego_konta' entry has a corresponding still-existing user row (proves no hard delete happened historically in preview DB either). E3 regression on DELETE /users/{id} still 100% (self-delete 400, last-admin 400, worker 200 archived, archived cannot login). Seed admin@bzone.app was NEVER modified persistently — status flip in the sole-admin test is reverted in finally and double-verified by the seed_admin_status_guard fixture; post-run check confirms seed status=aktywny and seed login → 200.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py:522-536 (delete_my_account) now correctly mirrors delete_user semantics: last-admin guard via count_documents({rola:'admin', status:'aktywny', id:{$ne:self}}) → 400, then $set status='zarchiwizowany', then project_members.delete_many, then audit 'usuniecie_wlasnego_konta'. No db.users.delete_one anywhere in server.py (grep-verified).

The last-admin guard fires ONLY when caller is admin AND no other active admins exist. This is the correct scope — non-admins skip the guard entirely and always soft-archive. Matches product intent (App Store compliance + evidentiary preservation).
Soft-archive keeps the user row for FK integrity (daily_reports, extra_hours, audit_log all reference user id). Status='zarchiwizowany' correctly gates login in /api/auth/login (line ~481-482).
project_members.delete_many is intentionally hard-deleted (junction table, no evidentiary value) — correct trade-off.
No regression on DELETE /users/{id}: 19/19 E3 tests still green.
